subject.title: fix: cloud-worker results are lost when the box dies before reconciliation

question: Should this maintainer-labeled cloud-worker persistence change wait for source-level review and contributor-owned live recovery proof?
rationale: The sandbox prevented inspection of the Git-ref, SQLite, and recovery paths, so the supplied context alone cannot settle correctness or upgrade safety.

options.title: Wait for complete review
options.body: Re-run the review in an environment that can inspect current source, history, and proof artifacts before merging.

options.title: Review manually
options.body: A cloud-worker owner can independently inspect the recovery and migration paths and confirm a live after-fix run.

recommendation.title: Wait for complete review
recommendation.body: Re-run the review in an environment that can inspect current source, history, and proof artifacts before merging.
